name: Mirrorblade
text:
This +2 greater striking keen khopesh is crafted from a nearly flawless reflective material, making its surfaces glimmer with a mesmerizing shine.

---
Activate—Mirage Guard 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You wave the mirrorblade around your head to create illusory distortions around you, making it difficult for opponents to judge your true position. For the next 10 minutes, you aren't Off-Guard to melee attacks from creatures flanking you.

---
Activate—Scryshield 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The mirrorblade's reflective surface dulls, and you and all your possessions are surrounded by a shimmering field that makes you invisible to scrying magic for 1 hour. In addition, you also learn about any scrying effects within a 30-foot emanation (as detect scrying). If you sheathe, drop, or attack with the mirrorblade, this effect ends early.
